video.desc:
A small-town boy who comes to Broadway alone will do anything—including sleeping with an ugly, overweight sugar daddy—just to land the role that puts him on stage opposite his idol in a teacher-student romance. When the younger actor asks to study under him, the older legend deliberately seduces him right in front of the very man who bought his way in. It starts as a cruel game—humiliating the pretty face who slept his way up—but through rehearsals and private moments that blur the line between performance and truth, the veteran finds himself falling for the one kid willing to sacrifice everything for a dream. Meanwhile, a secret the older man has buried for twenty years—a sham marriage, a closeted life—is about to push them both to the brink.
来自小镇的少年独自闯入百老汇。为了拿下一个能与偶像同台出演师生恋的角色，他不惜付出一切，甚至委身于一位其貌不扬、身材臃肿的金主，只为换来站上舞台的机会。
当他以新人演员的身份请求那位传奇前辈收他为学生时，对方却故意在金主面前撩拨他。起初，这不过是一场残忍的游戏——羞辱这个被认为靠脸和身体上位的漂亮男孩。
然而，在一次次排练与私下相处中，表演与真心的界限渐渐模糊。那位久经舞台的前辈，也在不知不觉间爱上了这个愿意为梦想孤注一掷的年轻人。
与此同时，前辈深埋二十年的秘密——一段有名无实的婚姻，以及多年不敢示人的真实身份——正将两人的关系推向崩溃边缘。
